artworks.title: Carrying the Cross
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving religious iconography and structures. The drawing depicts a group of figures engaged in a dramatic scene at the base of a large fortress or castle-like structure. At the center is a figure bearing a cross, surrounded by other figures who appear to be interacting with or guiding this central figure. The architectural elements include strong vertical lines and detailed stonework, conveying a medieval or early Christian setting. The sky is lightly etched with clouds. The drawing's lines and shading emphasize texture and form.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The drawing depicts three crosses set in an intricate composition, with a central cross bearing the label "INRI" at the top. The cross holds a figure with a halo, flanked by two other figures on crosses. In the foreground, there are several robed figures engaging in various activities, such as gesturing and looking up towards the central figure. The background features a landscape with a distant building visible in the horizon. The sky is depicted with swirling clouds. The use of hatching and detailed line work adds depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction taking place at a tomb or crypt. The scene depicts a carved box-like structure resembling a sarcophagus or altar situated under a natural stone formation or hollowed-out earth area, which is adorned with greenery. Surrounding the structure are several draped figures, likely involved in some act of offering or ritual, as they appear to interact with the sarcophagus. The figures are clad in flowing robes, rendered in fine linework that gives a sense of movement. The depiction captures a moment of solemn ritual or ceremonial action amidst a rocky, natural landscape, rendered in dense black and white hatching.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a group of figures gathered around a central tomb with supernatural elements above. The drawing features detailed line work in the style reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer or a similar artist known for intricate engraving. The figures in robes hold various items and tools, engaging in what appears to be a ritual or important gathering around the tomb. Above them, an ethereal figure surrounded by radiant clouds appears to ascend or hover. The fine hatching and cross-hatching techniques provide depth and texture to the drawing, enhancing its dramatic and narrative quality. This drawing is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Descent into Hell
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image portrays anthropomorphic figures and surreal architecture interacting in a scene. The setting shows stone walls with arched doorways and unique details like bones and skulls incorporated into the design. In the scene, a figure with a beak mask is using a long pole to check another creature. Above them, other creatures are present, one with a horn and another holding a rope. Clouds swirl in the background, creating an ominous atmosphere. The artwork features intricate line work, depicting a chaotic narrative within an old and deteriorating environment.

artworks.title: Garden of Eden
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a framed scene with a historical or mythological narrative. The central panel depicts a man and a woman near a tree with various animals in a natural setting. The details are highlighted by precise engraving. Surrounding the central scene are figures that may symbolize themes of mortality and time, including an hourglass or scythe. Below the central frame is a skeleton. The drawing is rich in allegorical content, with careful attention to anatomical detail and textural depth, combining nature with classical or biblical motifs.

artworks.title: Paradise Lost
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This print contains a central image with an angel, a skeleton, a man, and a woman. The central image is framed by columns with statues on them. One statue is of a male angel holding a scythe and hourglass, and the other is of a woman holding a thin hoop. There are also vases of flowers, candles, and a skeleton lying across the bottom next to a shovel and pickaxe. In the central image, a man and a woman appear to run towards the right, leaving a wooded area on the left. They are both nude, with furrowed brows and partially open mouths. On the right is a skeleton playing a cello or similar instrument. In the sky above, an angel emerges from swirling clouds, looking down at the running couple and wielding a long, curving sword. Below this central image and above the intricate border are a few lines of text.

artworks.title: When Adam Delved
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a scene showing a skeletal figure holding a scythe beside a human working the land with a spade. The background includes barren trees and sparse foliage. The frame includes columns holding symbols like candles and floral details. Below the central image, a skeleton is surrounded by farming tools.

artworks.title: The Pope
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description:
The image is a detailed etching. In the central part, a group of figures is depicted. To the left, a person seated is wearing a long robe and a papal crown. Beside this seated person, a robed and hooded figure is kneeling, holding a tall staff with a cross. Behind them, other standing figures are visible, some wearing mitres and religious vestments. A skeletal figure is present, likely symbolizing death.

The borders feature symbols like crowns, a skull, scrolls, and other artifacts. Above the central image, a shelf-like feature holds emblematic objects like an hourglass, skull, and another crown. Columns with floral decorations are part of the border, and at the bottom, armor pieces, weapons, and another skull are arranged. The background suggests a textured environment, possibly curtains or drapery.

artworks.title: Emperor
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: The image depicts a central scene with a regal figure seated on a throne, accompanied by a skeletal being. Surrounding them are standing figures in historical attire, with an hourglass and symbols of power at the base. The border contains additional figures holding weapons, and ornamental items adorn the top.

artworks.title: Empress
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is an image showing an architectural scene framed with allegorical figures and objects. The central section features individuals walking in front of a large building façade. The figures are in a procession, one holding a staff. The border around the central scene includes warrior-like figures, crowns, helmets, a skull, and ceremonial items. There are inscriptions on the edge of the frame. The composition reflects themes of power, authority, and transience.

artworks.title: Queen
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: The image contains several figures in a dramatic scene within an ornate frame. Six individuals are depicted in dynamic poses, with some trying to restrain others. The background shows an architectural setting with classical elements. Various objects are displayed at the top, and warrior figures are on each side. Additional items like a coffin, scrolls, and a skull are present at the bottom. The outer edges are adorned with architectural details.

artworks.title: Cardinal
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring allegorical and symbolic elements. In the center, two figures interact; one is a robed and hatted figure handing over money or documents above a table with scrolls, while another standing figure leans forward possibly in conversation. The scene is bordered by columns with figures on top, including a skull and a crown. The bottom section shows various objects like scrolls, weapons, and a skull. The drawing employs intricate line work and shading techniques reminiscent of historical engravings. Gothic script at the bottom includes a Latin phrase.

artworks.title: Duke
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a scene with a skeleton interacting with figures dressed in attire that suggests authority. The setting is a medieval street with grand buildings. The scene is enclosed by an ornate frame, with additional symbolic elements like helmets, crowns, and a skull in the borders. Latin text below suggests a narrative of mortality overcoming earthly power.

artworks.title: Bishop
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: Drawing of a bishop confronting death in a pastoral scene. A skeleton figure, representing death, is depicted in dark robes facing a bishop holding a crosier. Sheep graze nearby. The sun shines over hills and structures in the background. The scene is enclosed by a frame decorated with crowns, skulls, scepters, helmets, and garlands. Two armored figures stand on either side. A Latin inscription is at the bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: Count
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This image shows a skeletal figure facing a warrior. The skeletal figure is holding a scythe and shield, while the warrior is wearing ornate armor and a plumed hat. The scene is surrounded by columns with classical elements and various symbolic items like helmets and a crown with a skull. The base of the columns features armor pieces and a skull. The fencing and architecture in the image create depth and drama.

artworks.title: Abbot
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cloaked figure interacting with a skeletal figure amidst ornate and symbolic elements. The central image depicts a skeletal figure with a crown, holding a spade and a staff with a crown hooked on it, engaged in a dynamic pose against a cloaked figure holding a book and a yoke. The backdrop reveals a picturesque countryside with small structures, trees, and clouds in the sky. Surrounding this scene, the border is adorned with symbolic items such as crowns, masks, and what appears to be a papal tiara. These items rest atop columns where two armored figures flank the central scene, one holding a spear and shield while the other leans on a club. Below the main scene, a Latin inscription is etched into the frame, referencing Proverbs 5:23. Additionally, the base of the image features an arrangement of objects including a skull, hat, and sword. The entire artwork is intricately detailed, illustrating a theme of life, death, knowledge, and power through its symbolic and allegorical elements.

artworks.title: Abbess
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton and allegorical scenes with death. In the center, there is an elaborate framed depiction of a skeletal figure representing death, holding a scythe and engaging with figures in medieval attire. The setting appears to be a medieval courtyard, with arches and Gothic architectural elements. Surrounding this central narrative is an ornately detailed architectural frame that includes pilasters topped with urns or decorative vases and two female figures holding vessels on either side. At the bottom, a skeleton is artistically displayed, forming a memento mori theme. The drawing uses intricate line work to depict these rich textures and elaborate details.

artworks.title: Monk
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with allegorical elements involving death and time. In the center, a skeletal figure grasps the arm of a robed figure. The background features swirling clouds and classical architectural elements. On either side, two standing figures are shown, one holding an hourglass and scythe and the other holding a circle or wreath. At the bottom, a skeleton lies with a shovel. The composition is framed by ornate architectural motifs with Latin text below.

artworks.title: Nun
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene framed by ornate architectural elements. The central scene depicts three figures in a chapel-like interior, with one figure in the rear appearing skeletal and holding an hourglass. The other two figures are kneeling and praying towards a crucifix at the altar. The setting features large arch windows with classical detailing. Surrounding the central tableau is an elaborate frame with columns on either side, each adorned with urn-like decorations. Above and below the central scene are cherub-like figures, with skeletal motifs prominently featured, including skulls and bones.

artworks.title: Preacher
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scholarly scene. The central image shows a scholarly figure standing at a podium, with an audience seated below, all dressed in medieval attire. The scene is surrounded by architectural columns and arches. The border features classical motifs including cherubs, skulls, and gargoyles. The bottom inscription is in Latin.

artworks.title: Doctor
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed and symbolic scene featuring a skeletal figure in a medieval setting. The central image depicts an interaction between a skeletal figure and a seated figure holding an open book. The skeletal figure is presented within a room adorned with shelves holding bottles and flasks. Surrounding the central image are border elements, including figures holding objects like a globe and an hourglass, alongside putti and skulls.

artworks.title: Knight
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight fighting a skeletal figure. The central scene shows a heavily armored knight facing off against a skeleton with a spear. The background depicts a chaotic battlefield with more skeletons in combat. There are skulls and weapons scattered around the scene. The drawing is framed with columns, helmets, and regalia. The detailed shading adds dramatic tension to the image, highlighting the theme of mortality.

artworks.title: Advocate
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a skeleton interacting with three clothed figures. The skeleton stands in an archway, engaging with the figures who are dressed in period attire. The background shows a street scene with European architectural elements. Surrounding the central scene is an ornate frame with cherubic figures, skulls, and columns, with Latin text at the bottom. The artwork is detailed with intricate linework.
